# Relationship Links

## Contract
The wire shape of linked cards. Each `linksTo`/`linksToMany` field
serializes under `relationships`, keyed by field name (indexed keys for
many):

```json
"relationships": {
  "account": { "links": { "self": "../Account/acme-industries" } },
  "linkedExamples.0": { "links": { "self": "../Theme/midnight-marker" } }
}
```

Invariants:
- `links.self` is the authoritative pointer — when both appear,
  `links.self` beats `data.id` (binary-copy installers that trusted
  `data.id` dropped files; hard-won).
- A null relationship is `{ "links": { "self": null } }`, not an absent
  key.
- Links may be relative (resolved against the instance URL) or absolute.

## Captured example
Captured from `Invoice/inv-2026-018.json` in this realm (account + owner
links above).

## Source
Shape: `runtime-common/card-document-shape.ts`; field kinds:
